Source evidence: chai prakan district (, ) is a district ("amphoe") in the northern part of chiang mai province in northern thailand.

neighbouring districts are (from the south clockwise) phrao, chiang dao, fang of chiang mai province and mae suai of chiang rai province.

the khun tan range stretches from north to south along the eastern side of the district.
